sentences.text:
Learned State counsel has taken this Court to paragraphs 8 and 9 to the counter-affidavit filed on behalf of the respondent No. 3 and 4 which read as follows:
"8. That the award for the said project has been declared on 01.03.2013 Accordingly,
the compensation amount of Rs. 1417165/- for plot no. 1 area 0.69 decimal to Sidheswar Singh the petitioner no. 3 on 30.06.2016 and the compensation amount of Rs. 229889/-+160345/-= 390234/- has been Patna High Court CWJC No.9104 of 2016(2) dt.13-02-2024 paid to Smt. Khatrani Devi w/e Sidheshwar Singh on 23.02.2016 & 09.06.2016.
9. That the compensation amount for the land of Khata No. 303, plot no. 01 area 69 decimal and Khata No. 68, piot no. 02 area 0.19 decimal has already been paid and as such, the grievance of the petitioner stand redressed."
4.
This counter-affidavit was filed in the year 2016 and there is no rejoinder rebutting the claim.
This Court is convinced that the grievance of the petitioner has been redressed.
5. However, since no one has appeared, accordingly the case is dismissed for non prosecution.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
